verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms GitLab has merge requests, its equivalent of pull requests, as a core way to propose and review changes: agents turn issues into merge requests, security findings appear in MRs, and Chat can access MRs. The GitHub importer also carries over pull requests and review comments. Nothing in the pack documents forking a repository or opening merge requests from a fork. missing for 10: documented fork capability for outside contributors, fork-to-upstream merge request workflow, contributor permission controls for external forks, hands-on corroboration of the open-source contribution flow.
